{
  "name": "combo-meter",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Fighting-game combo meter for Claude Code: every clean tool call is a hit, every error breaks the chain. Ranks D to SSS, special moves, and an all-time high score.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "Sarthak Bhatore",
    "url": "https://github.com/sarthak2511"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mods",
    "game",
    "combo",
    "status-line",
    "statusline",
    "streak",
    "arcade",
    "fun",
    "hooks"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "sound": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Sound effects",
      "description": "Play the chiptune effects on rank up, specials, breaks and records (macOS plays them; other systems stay silent).",
      "default": true
    },
    "style": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Band style",
      "description": "big draws the pixel-art combo counter; compact keeps the band to one line.",
      "default": "big",
      "options": [
        "big",
        "compact"
      ]
    }
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/sarthak2511/claude-combo",
  "repository": "https://github.com/sarthak2511/claude-combo",
  "license": "MIT"
}
